root_cause_analysis: Instagram Graph API failed to download media from raw.githubusercontent.com (Subcode 2207052 / Code 9004). Meta's crawler could not retrieve the image due to URL host limitations, missing/unsupported headers, or network restrictions on raw GitHub content links.
actionable_instructions: Migrate image hosting from raw.githubusercontent.com to a supported public CDN or S3/GCS bucket.
Ensure the hosting provider returns strict HTTP 200 responses with valid 'image/png' Content-Type headers accessible to Meta IP ranges.
